title: Stasis Shell & Lantern
description: A vibrant underwater library scene features a large, ornate sea turtle floating centrally, its shell decorated with glowing hourglasses and green symbols, wearing a red floral crown. A person in purple robes ties a red ribbon to a lantern on a coral shelf lined with books, glowing jars, and an open book, beneath a banner reading 'Stasis Shell & Lantern' and 'Festival of Stasis'.
prompt: A majestic sea turtle with an intricately decorated shell featuring glowing hourglasses and emerald runes swims through a magical underwater library during the Festival of Stasis. The turtle wears a crown of red flowers. Surrounding it are coral shelves filled with ancient books, glowing lanterns, and hourglasses. A person in purple robes ties a red ribbon to a lantern in the foreground. Light beams shine down from above, with red and green paper lanterns floating near a banner that reads 'Stasis Shell & Lantern'.
